name: Secure Network Configuration Management System
description: Design a secure network configuration management system for a university that manages configuration changes across routers, switches, wireless controllers, and other network infrastructure. Authorized network administrators should be able to review current configurations, submit configuration changes, track change history, and restore previously approved configurations when necessary. The system should detect unauthorized or unexpected configuration changes, generate security alerts, maintain audit logs of configuration activity and administrator actions, and restrict administrative functions based on approved roles. The platform should provide a centralized dashboard, integrate with existing university identity services, support multiple campus locations, and remain secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable.
